parameters.query:
WITH u AS (
  INSERT INTO users (google_sub, email, name, last_login_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  ON CONFLICT (google_sub) DO UPDATE SET
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    name  = EXCLUDED.name,
    last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  RETURNING id, email, name, company_id
)
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.company_id,
       (cp.setup_completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS setup_complete
FROM u LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = u.company_id;
